free_tier.stated: A sale published on 2026-08-07 lists dedicated servers from USD 25 a month with 32 GB RAM, 1 TB of disk and 40 TB of bandwidth, in Los Angeles or Buffalo, with AMD or Intel hardware. The same vendor's earlier sale listed an Intel Xeon E3-1240 with 16 GB, a 1 TB SSD, 10 TB of bandwidth, a 1 Gbps port and a /30 IPv4 at USD 178.08 a year, which is USD 14.84 a month, and a Xeon E3-1270v6 with 64 GB and a 1 TB SSD at USD 49.88 a month.

notes: New record: no colocrossing file exists in dossier/compute. The rung is `reported` because the vendor's own dedicated page is a marketing article with no price table and the only dated numbers come from LowEndBox, which is a third-party deals site quoting the vendor's sale. The CPU model of the USD 25 machine is not stated anywhere I could read, so it is null: a reader who needs the generation should assume nothing. The annual figure of USD 14.84 a month is a 2024 sale and is recorded to show the shape of this vendor's discounting, not as a current price. ColoCrossing being a HostPapa brand is the reliability fact that matters in a lane where the usual failure is an operator that disappears.
